name: Q-Bench-HF
description: Q-Bench-HF is a Hugging Face-hosted collection intended to evaluate language models on question-answering and reasoning tasks across multiple short-form prompts. It measures models' ability to produce correct, concise answers and handle a variety of question types. The benchmark aggregates items designed to test factual knowledge and basic reasoning.
reputation: Relatively low-profile and niche; available on Hugging Face but not widely cited in major benchmark comparisons.
